SELECT 'store' k, store_key::VARCHAR a, store_id::VARCHAR b, store_name c, city d, format e, valid_from::VARCHAR f, valid_to::VARCHAR g, close_date::VARCHAR h FROM dim_store WHERE lower(store_name) LIKE '%nokia%' OR lower(city) LIKE '%nokia%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fc', fiscal_year, fiscal_period::VARCHAR, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date::VARCHAR, period_end_date::VARCHAR, weeks_in_period::VARCHAR, fully_loaded::VARCHAR, '' FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period=5

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE period_start_date <= DATE '2026-10-15' AND period_end_date >= DATE '2025-09-01' ORDER BY period_start_date

SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) dist_rl, sum(f.quantity) units, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) staff_units, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, min(f.etl_loaded_at) mn, max(f.etl_loaded_at) mx, string_agg(DISTINCT f.channel_code, ',') ch
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'closure' k, closure_id::VARCHAR a, closure_type b, closure_start_date::VARCHAR c, closure_end_date::VARCHAR d FROM ref_store_closure WHERE store_id=118
UNION ALL SELECT 'prodver', count(*)::VARCHAR, count(DISTINCT sku)::VARCHAR, sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::VARCHAR, '' FROM dim_product
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_dupes', count(*)::VARCHAR, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id)::VARCHAR, '', '' FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT p.subcategory sub, sum(f.quantity) gross, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) staff, count(*) nlines, max(f.quantity) maxq
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
  SELECT p.subcategory sub, sum(r.quantity_returned) ret_units
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=118 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT sold.sub, gross, staff, gross-staff ex_staff, coalesce(ret_units,0) ret_units, gross-coalesce(ret_units,0) net_of_returns, nlines, maxq
FROM sold LEFT JOIN ret USING (sub) ORDER BY gross DESC LIMIT 8
